name: order-webapp
description: Single-page React application serving all three signed-in roles — Customer, Staff, and Delivery Courier — each with their own set of screens behind one shell: customers track their own orders, staff manage the full order dashboard and lifecycle, couriers see and update their assigned deliveries. Talks only to order-api; holds no business logic or credentials of its own, and performs no order creation via direct external-API integration.

dependencies.name: order-api
dependencies.description: Backend API for orders, statuses, courier assignment, and dashboard data — the webapp's only data source.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder-issued OIDC client used to sign in Customers, Staff, and Delivery Couriers via the platform IDP.
